name: BrowseComp-Plus
intro: BrowseComp-Plus 把原始 BrowseComp 的 1,266 个问答对转为 830 个证据链经人工验证的查询，并配套 100,195 篇固定去重语料、Evidence/Gold qrels 和困难负样本。它可在相同语料上解耦分析检索器、Agent 推理、引用和上下文工程。
build_method: o3证据挖掘, 14人超过400小时人工验证, GPT-4o子查询分解, Google困难负样本挖掘
metric: Answer Accuracy, Recall, Search Calls, Citation Precision/Recall, Evidence/Gold Recall@5/100/1000, NDCG@10
task_type: Agent任务, 开放式问答, 事实验证
eval_feature: 固定语料可复现评测, 检索与Agent解耦, BM25/稠密/Oracle对比, 引用落地性
scale: 830个验证查询, 100,195篇去重文档; 平均6.1篇Evidence、76.28篇困难负样本、2.9篇Gold/查询
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2508.06600 and the official repository. The diagram preserves the 1,266 original BrowseComp pairs, o3 clue/URL/snippet mining, filtering to 1,142 queries with initial evidence, fourteen annotators spending over 400 hours with over 80% agreement, the final 830 verified queries, separate Evidence and Gold document labels, GPT-4o decomposition into about seven sub-queries, Google Search API hard-negative mining, the fixed 100,195-document corpus and per-query averages, BM25/Qwen3-Embedding/ReasonIR/Oracle retrieval, top-5 results truncated to 512 tokens, optional full-document access, iterative cited answering, answer accuracy/recall/search calls, citation precision/recall, Evidence and Gold Recall@5/100/1000, and NDCG@10.
task_type_en: Agent Task, Open-ended QA, Fact Verification
build_method_en: o3 evidence mining, over 400 hours of verification by 14 annotators, GPT-4o sub-query decomposition, Google hard-negative mining
eval_feature_en: Reproducible fixed corpus, retriever-agent disentanglement, BM25/dense/oracle comparison, citation grounding
intro_en: BrowseComp-Plus converts 1,266 original BrowseComp question-answer pairs into 830 human-verified evidence-chain queries backed by a fixed corpus of 100,195 deduplicated documents, Evidence/Gold qrels, and hard negatives. It supports controlled, component-level analysis of retrieval, agent reasoning, citations, and context engineering.
